title: 第25章 表演与突破第26章 有借无还夏令月
slug: 暮年太子每天增加一点精神
content_zh:
消息传出的第一时间，还在东宫的星衍娘子就来到文华殿，向夏无恙赔礼道歉，又送上一批龙虎大药。
消息虽然不是她传出去的，但是却跟她息息相关，星衍娘子并没有告诉他那人是谁，但是通过摄魂术，探查了星衍娘子的浅层想法以后，夏无恙知道了对方的身份。
万剑庄主！
对方嫉妒于星衍娘子对夏无恙的余情未了，再加上星衍娘子一直跟他保持距离，让他以为这一切都是因为夏无恙的缘故。
即使星衍娘子再三请求，让他不要传播此事，可是万剑庄主还是食言了，将这件事情传了出去。
显然他并不想让夏无恙顺利地服用这些龙虎大药和天水精华，从而延长寿命，苟延残喘更长时间。
因为这件事情，星衍娘子跟他吵了一架，两人如今已经陷入冷战。
星衍娘子觉得过意不去，这才来到文华殿道歉，觉得是自己行事出了岔子，让夏无恙遭受无妄之灾。
夏无恙却并没有怨怪她，通过摄魂术，他已经知道这一切不是星衍娘子的错。
至于星衍娘子为何要把这件事情告诉万剑庄主，自然是因为部分龙虎大药和天水精华乃是万剑庄主帮忙筹措，他怎么可能不知道。
消息刚刚传出去，夏无恙就察觉到了异常，第一时间让魏贤仁和刘隽上门“抢夺”丹药，表演了一场好戏，让外界以为他只服用了一份半天水精华，其余的都被魏贤仁和刘隽抢走了。
两人也第一时间“服用”下去，可惜并没有冲破困扰已久的瓶颈桎梏。
对此外界没有怀疑，毕竟魏贤仁和刘隽的天赋资质众所皆知，普普通通，寻常之极，能够提升到中三品已经快要耗尽了东宫的资源和宝物。
之前也不是没有服用过奇宝，有过失败的记录，这次再失败似乎也说得过去。
让夏无恙没有想到的是，就连刘隽背后的五皇子也关注到了这件事情，眼看着谋夺不到天水精华，便命令刘隽将一部分龙虎大药呈递过去。
为了避免惹人怀疑，夏无恙不得不忍痛送出了几百瓶龙虎大药，让刘隽拿去交差，避免惹人怀疑。
好在他如今能够随意从内库支取龙虎大药，就算失去了几百瓶，也没有那么心疼，接下来更不会缺少修炼资源。
期间刘隽故作无意地泄露了此事，让外界知道夏无恙的龙虎大药也被抢夺的差不多了，剩下的已经没有多少，总算能够安静下来。
不过心中对于五皇子夏无殇，已经起了杀心。
竟然敢谋夺自己好不容易得到的龙虎大药，阻碍他的修行，夏无恙岂能不杀他。

夏无殇乃是众多皇子皇女中最富裕的一个，母亲容妃出身于江南第一商盟天宝阁，富可敌国，掌握了大夏皇朝三成以上的漕运和盐铁贸易。
夏无殇自身也是上三品武者，未来皇位的有力竞争者，居然还会谋夺他这个垂暮太子的龙虎大药，吃相未免太过难看。
果然越是有钱之人就越是小气，连这点儿蝇头小利都不愿意放过。
除此之外，他以前针对过夏无恙多次，东宫很多产业和资源就是被夏无殇低价买走，说是购买，其实跟强抢没有太大的区别。
可惜现在实力不够，若是有了足够的实力，夏无恙定会像对待云舒公主一样，第一时间去灭了他。
既然已经解决了这个意外，修为境界也巩固下来，那么该是冲击更高层次的时候。
一瓶天水精华落入口中，滚滚药力汹涌而来，不断地提升着龙虎气血，淬炼着每一根骨骼，很快就达到了瓶颈桎梏。
content_en:
As soon as the news came out, Lady Xingyan, who was still in the East Palace, came to the Wenhua Hall, apologized to Xia Wuyang, and sent another batch of dragon and tiger medicine.
Although the news was not spread by her, it was closely related to her. Madam Xingyan did not tell him who the person was, but after using the soul-obsessing technique to explore Madam Xingyan's shallow thoughts, Xia Wuyang knew the identity of the other party.
Master Wanjian!
The other party was jealous of Lady Xingyan's unresolved love for Xia Wuhuang. In addition, Lady Xingyan had always kept a distance from him, making him think that all this was because of Xia Wuhuang.
Even though Mrs. Xingyan repeatedly requested him not to spread this matter, Master Wanjian still broke his promise and spread the matter.
Obviously, he didn't want Xia Wuyou to take these dragon and tiger medicines and Tianshui essence smoothly, thereby extending his life and surviving for a longer period of time.
Because of this incident, Lady Xingyan had a quarrel with him, and the two have now fallen into a cold war.
Madam Xingyan felt very sorry, so she came to the Wenhua Hall to apologize. She felt that she had made a mistake in her behavior and caused Xia Wuchang to suffer an unreasonable disaster.
Xia Wuyang did not blame her. Through the soul-stirring technique, he already knew that all this was not Lady Xingyan's fault.
As for why Madam Xingyan told Master Wanjian about this matter, it was naturally because Master Wanjian helped raise part of the Dragon Tiger Medicine and Tianshui Essence. How could he not know about it.
As soon as the news spread, Xia Wuyang noticed something unusual, and immediately asked Wei Xianren and Liu Jun to come to "rob" the elixir. He put on a good show, making the outside world think that he only took a half-day water essence, and the rest were snatched away by Wei Xianren and Liu Jun.
The two of them also "taken it" immediately, but unfortunately they did not break through the long-standing bottleneck.
The outside world has no doubt about this. After all, Wei Xianren and Liu Jun's talents are well known. They are ordinary and extremely ordinary. Being able to be promoted to the third grade of middle school has almost exhausted the resources and treasures of the East Palace.
It’s not like I haven’t taken Qibao before, and I have a record of failure. It seems reasonable to fail again this time.
What Xia Wuchang didn't expect was that even the fifth prince behind Liu Jun also paid attention to this matter. Seeing that he couldn't get the essence of Tianshui, he ordered Liu Jun to hand over a part of the dragon and tiger medicine.
In order to avoid arousing suspicion, Xia Wuyang had to reluctantly give away hundreds of bottles of dragon and tiger medicine for Liu Jun to deliver to avoid arousing suspicion.
Fortunately, he can now freely withdraw the Dragon and Tiger elixir from the inner treasury. Even if he loses hundreds of bottles, he won't feel so distressed, and he will not be short of cultivation resources in the future.
During this period, Liu Jun pretended to unintentionally leak the matter, letting the outside world know that almost all of Xia Wuhuang's Dragon and Tiger Medicine had been robbed, and there was not much left, so he was finally able to calm down.
However, he already had murderous intentions towards the fifth prince Xia Wushang.
He actually dared to steal the dragon-tiger medicine that he had finally obtained and hindered his cultivation. How could Xia Wuchang not kill him?
Xia Wushang was the richest among the many princes and daughters. Her mother, Concubine Rong, was born in Tianbao Pavilion, the first merchant alliance in the south of the Yangtze River. She was as wealthy as anyone in the country and controlled more than 30% of the water transportation and salt and iron trade of the Great Xia Dynasty.
Xia Wushang himself was a third-grade warrior and a strong contender for the throne in the future. He would actually try to steal the dragon-tiger medicine from him, the dying prince. It would be too ugly to look at him.
Sure enough, the richer people are, the stingier they are, and they are not willing to let go of even this small profit.
In addition, he had targeted Xia Wushang many times before. Many properties and resources in the East Palace were bought by Xia Wushang at low prices. It was said to be a purchase, but in fact it was not much different from robbery.
It's a pity that he is not strong enough now. If he had enough strength, Xia Wuyang would definitely kill him as soon as possible just like he did with Princess Yunshu.
Now that this accident has been resolved and the cultivation realm has been consolidated, it is time to hit a higher level.
A bottle of skyThe water essence fell into the mouth, and the rolling medicinal power surged in, continuously increasing the dragon and tiger's energy and blood, tempering every bone, and soon reached the bottleneck.
